webViewUsage.usage: Embeds YouTube Live stream broadcast (Makkah & Madinah Live).
webViewUsage.webImplementation: Native <iframe> element with YouTube nocookie embed
securityControls: Source validation: event.source must strictly equal iframeRef.current.contentWindow
Origin validation: origin must match https://www.youtube.com, https://www.youtube-nocookie.com, or https://youtube.com
Payload sanitization: only known numeric YouTube IFrame API error codes (2, 5, 100, 101, 150) trigger state changes
No arbitrary JavaScript execution or exposed native bridge interfaces

evaluation: PASS - WebView usage is strictly restricted to YouTube Live broadcasts with origin and source validation; zero raw HTML injection vectors exist in codebase.
